Vile 2-Kateshe

✨ Shitet vile 2-Kateshe ne kompleksin me te ri prej 14-vilash moderne qe po ndertohen ne Daias vetem 10 minta larg qendres tregtare TEG. Vila eshte ndertuar me materialet me cilesore Italiane e ideuar me detaje nga arkitektet dhe organizuar ne dy kate te cilat lidhen me njera – tjetren me shkalle te brendshme. Katit i pare organizohet nga soxhorno, ambienti i gatimit, tualeti i perbashket i katit dhe nje dhome gjumi me tualet personal. Kati i dyte organizohet nga koridori shperndares, 3 dhoma gjumi ku secila ka tualet personal dhe ballkoni. Prona ofron privatesi dhe nje jetese komode familiare prane natyres, ajo disponon nje oborr, post parkimi dhe gjithashtu nje pishine. Vila eshte ende ne faze ndertimi, ku brenda afatit 1-vjecar pritet te kete perfunduar i gjithe kompleksi. Prona ofron privatesi, qetesi dhe nje jetese komode familiare prane natyres. Gjithashtu nje investim shume i mire.
Zona ku ndodhet eshte mjaft e qete dhe shume prane kryeqytetit, e cila ne vitet e ardhshme do te kete dhe zhvillimin me te madh, kjo per shkak te projekteve te medha qe priten te behen aty.
Organizimi i Prones:
• 3 ambiente ndenje
• 1 dhome gatimi dhe ngrenje
• 3 korridore shperndares
• 4 dhoma gjumi
• 3 tualete
• 1 oborr i shtrire ne tre orientime
• Verande
Agjenti: Bjornida Banaj

title_en: For sale, II Storey Villa, Complex in Daias, near TEG, 2500 Euro/M²
description_en: For sale, two-storey villa, complex in Daias, near TEG, 2500 Euro/M². Property features: Daias 2-Storey Villa, Tirana 10 minutes from Teg shopping center Total Area 300 m² Price 2500 euro/m² (slightly negotiable) Property Organization: • Living room • Kitchen • Corridor and internal staircase • 4 bedrooms • 5 bathrooms • Pool • Veranda • Parking post ✨ 2-Storey Villa for sale in the newest complex of 14 modern villas being built in Daia, only 10 minutes away from the TEG shopping center. The villa is built with high-quality Italian materials, designed in detail by the architects and organized in two floors which are connected to one another - the other by an internal staircase. The first floor is organized by a living room, a kitchen, a shared toilet on the first floor and a bedroom with a private toilet. The second floor is organized by the distribution corridor, 3 bedrooms, each with its own bathroom and balcony. The property offers privacy and a comfortable family life close to nature, it has a yard, parking lot and also a swimming pool. The villa is still under construction, where the entire complex is expected to be completed within the 1-year deadline. The property offers privacy, tranquility and a comfortable family life close to nature. Also a very good investment. The area where it is located is quite quiet and very close to the capital, which in the coming years will have the biggest development, this is because of the big projects that are expected to be done there.
